resources.string: Start Bluetooth starts the selected sensor emulator. On a second phone, open Libre 3 address helper, or use Find another emulator in Juggluco. It finds and reports the address automatically. Then start NFC on the Proxmark host and scan it with the reader.
Latest Juggluco glucose on the host
Simulation check interval (seconds; live readings send on arrival)

NFC must contain the address of the selected sensor emulator. The separate Libre 3 address helper needs no Juggluco installation on the scanning phone. Both it and Find another emulator report the found address automatically. Use a scanning phone that is not paired with the host. Discover Bluetooth address asks a Wear companion; a paired companion may return a saved identity and is rejected. Refresh discovery if Android changes the address.

The included genuine certificate works with the known security version 1 app key. Use latest real sensor also imports its captured certificate when available. Changing the Sensor ID does not generate a new certificate.
Pairing and activation reset requested. Reset the reader pairing as well before pairing again.
Bluetooth permissions are needed to advertise, discover the address and accept a connection. Allow them on the selected host too.
No advertising address has been discovered yet

Events are saved on the selected Bluetooth host. Sending an event updates patch status immediately; the reader can then request the event log. Event codes are the displayed numbers, such as 4004 or 4193. The captured example requires an empty log and represents events at minutes 0, 8 and 1616; set the sensor start time accordingly before starting Bluetooth.
Example filled. Press Send event to store it and notify the reader. Use a new index for each further event.
Clear stored events and send status
Clearing removes the host event log. The reader may retain events it already received; use a different Sensor ID for a fresh test. Patch state and disconnect reasons use the fields above.
Event log read from the selected host.
Saved on the selected host. A connected, subscribed reader is notified; otherwise it receives the status on its next connection.
Index Minute Error data Event code
